settings.delete_account_notes:
If you wish to delete your account, please fill in the reason and submit it using the button below.

Important Notes:
・It may take some time for the account to be deleted after the deletion request is submitted.
・Game records are shared with your opponent, so it may take time before they are deleted.
・The account deletion cannot be undone.
・If you user our other games with the same account, the account will be deleted from all games.

Open the Google Play Store
Tap on your profile icon at the top right
Go to 'Payments & subscriptions' → 'Subscriptions'
Select @:app.title and tap 'Cancel Subscription'
